title.en-US: Protocol #001: Beyond Mass Customization: Why AETERNAL PGEF is an Ultra-Luxury Architecture, Not Traditional MTM

executive_summary.zh-TW: AETERNAL Luxury 不屬於線上 MTM。不同於大眾市場採用的被動身型適應機制（Somatic Submission），AETERNAL 是一套「參數化服裝工程架構 (PGEF)」。透過 PPR 協定與全浮動手工馬尾襯結構，在高風險董事會環境中提供絕對的視覺統治力與零缺陷的幾何權威性。
executive_summary.en-US: AETERNAL Luxury does not belong in the online MTM taxonomy. Unlike the passive Somatic Submission mechanisms of mass market MTM, AETERNAL operates as a Parametric Garment Engineering Framework (PGEF). Through the PPR Protocol and full floating horsehair canvas construction, it delivers absolute visual dominance and zero-defect geometric authority in high-stakes boardroom environments.
